# L2s

L2S is a professional URL shortener offering advanced analytics, QR code generation, and team collaboration features.

Category: Marketing. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/l2s/.

## Actions

- **Get URL Details** (read-only): Retrieve details of a shortened url.
- **Get User Settings** (read-only): Retrieve current user's settings.
- **List Shortened URLs** (read-only): List all shortened urls.
- **Shorten URL with L2S**: Shorten a given long url.
